---

## 1. Purpose & Goals

**Primary goal:**
Help engineering and construction-related companies quickly understand what Mosaic does and book a call or submit roles.

**Secondary goals:**

* Capture employers for:

  * Per-position recruiting
  * Fractional recruiter tiers
  * Grand Slam offers
  * Sourcing-only services
* Capture candidates for:

  * Free Resume Book (freemium)
  * Paid resume/LinkedIn packages
  * Featured Candidate placements

**Target audiences:**

1. **Employers**

   * Civil, environmental, transportation, structural, geotechnical, industrial, construction management, utilities, etc.
   * Titles: Owners, VPs, Directors, HR Leaders, Hiring Managers.

2. **Candidates**

   * Engineering professionals: entry-level to senior PE, PMs, CM, and related business roles (marketing, finance, operations in engineering firms).

---

## 2. High-Level Site Map

1. **Home**
2. **About**
3. **Employer Solutions**

   * Full-Cycle Recruiting
   * Fractional TA (Talent Acquisition) Tiers
   * Sourcing-Only Services
4. **Pricing & Grand Slam Offers**
5. **Candidate Services**

   * Freemium Resume Book (Join Free)
   * Featured Candidate Upgrade
   * Career Branding Packages
6. **Talent Hub**

   * Resume Book (search/filter – Phase 2)
   * Featured Candidates (curated profiles)
7. **Resources / Insights** (blog/articles)
8. **Contact / Book a Call**

Global elements:

* **Header/Nav**
* **Footer**
* **Sticky “Book a Call” or “Talk to Neha” button**

---

## 3. Global Design & Brand Requirements

* **Brand name:** Mosaic Talent Consulting
* **Tone:** Professional, engineering-savvy, modern, niche, high-trust.
* **Aesthetic:** Clean, modern, slightly luxury; similar seriousness to a boutique consulting firm + tech startup.
* **Colors:**

  * Primary: Teal, charcoal
  * Accent: Gold
  * Background: White / very light gray
* **Imagery:**

  * Engineering project visuals (bridges, roads, site plans, office teams)
  * Abstract mosaics / geometric shapes
  * Diverse professionals (men/women, different ethnicities)
* **Key motif:** “Mosaic” = multiple pieces coming together → talent, skills, projects, diversity.

---

## 4. Page-by-Page Functional Spec

---

### 4.1 Home

**Objectives:**

* Immediately communicate:

  * “We recruit engineers, by an engineer.”
  * Niche: civil & construction-related roles.
* Fast path for employers to **Book a Call**.
* Secondary path for candidates to **Join the Resume Book**.

**Sections:**

1. **Hero Section**

   * Headline example:

     > “Recruiting, Engineered Better.”
     > or
     > “Engineers Recruiting Engineers.”
   * Subheadline:

     > “Mosaic Talent Consulting specializes in civil, environmental, and construction management talent. Built by an engineer & MBA with 25+ years in engineering and talent acquisition.”
   * Primary CTA: **[Book a Call]**
   * Secondary CTA: **[Post a Role]** / **[See Pricing]**

2. **Niche & Authority Strip**

   * Logos or text list of companies/industries founder has worked with: FactSet, Cisco, Pratt & Whitney, TRC, M&J Engineering, DKI, etc.
   * Short tagline: “25+ years in engineering and recruiting.”

3. **Venn Diagram Section (Key Differentiator)**

   * Visual of three intersecting circles:

     * Engineering
     * Marketing (Business)
     * Recruiting
   * Center label: “Mosaic Talent Consulting”
   * Short bullets under each circle:

     * Engineering → “We speak your technical language.”
     * Marketing → “We position your roles to attract top talent.”
     * Recruiting → “We run a fast, structured hiring process.”

4. **Services Overview (for Employers)**

   * 3 cards:

     * **Full-Cycle Recruiting (Per Position)**
     * **Fractional Talent Acquisition**
     * **Sourcing-Only Pipelines**
   * Each card with:

     * One-line description
     * Link to detailed Employer Solutions page.

5. **Grand Slam Offers (Teaser)**

   * 3 columns:

     * Engineering Hiring Accelerator – from $5,000/mo
     * Fractional TA Elite – from $12,500/mo
     * Candidate Sourcing Machine – from $2,500/mo
   * Link: **[View Full Pricing & Offers]**

6. **Candidates Section**

   * Brief explanation of:

     * Free Resume Book
     * Featured Candidate upgrades
   * CTA: **[Join the Resume Book Free]**

7. **Founder Section**

   * Short founder profile:

     * Engineer (EIT), MBA in Marketing & Entrepreneurship
     * Former VP / Head of Talent / Director of TA at engineering firms
     * “Born into a civil engineering & construction management family.”
   * CTA: **[Learn More About Mosaic]**

8. **Final CTA**

   * Split CTAs:

     * Employers: **[Book a Discovery Call]**
     * Candidates: **[Get Resume & LinkedIn Help]**

---

### 4.2 About

**Purpose:** Establish deep credibility and tell the “why Mosaic” story.

**Content/Sections:**

* **Founder Story**

  * Engineering background, MBA, career arc.
* **Mosaic Method**

  * Explain intersection of Engineering + Marketing + Recruiting.
* **Timeline / Experience Highlights**

  * FactSet, Cisco, Pratt & Whitney, TRC, M&J, DKI, etc.
* **Values**

  * Diversity, speed, quality, transparency.
* CTA: **[Work With Mosaic]**

---

### 4.3 Employer Solutions

**Goal:** Explain service offerings in detail and guide to **Book a Call** or **Submit a Role**.

**Sections:**

1. **Overview**

   * Short summary of how Mosaic works with engineering firms.

2. **Full-Cycle Recruiting (Per-Position Tiers)**

   * Tier A: Standard Roles – $5K/mo, 3-month min
   * Tier B: Technical / PE-Track – $7.5–10K/mo
   * Tier C: Senior / Leadership – $15–20K/mo
   * For each tier:

     * Role examples
     * Deliverables
     * Time-to-fill estimates
     * Value vs traditional 20–25% fee.

3. **Fractional Talent Acquisition Tiers**

   * Tier 1: Starter – $5K/mo (up to 3 roles)
   * Tier 2: Growth – $7.5–10K/mo (up to 8 roles)
   * Tier 3: Elite Partner – $15–20K/mo (up to 20 roles)
   * For each tier:

     * What’s included (dedicated recruiter, pipelines, reporting, etc.).
     * Good for firms hiring X per year.

4. **Sourcing-Only Services**

   * Sourcing only vs Sourcing + Outreach.
   * Pricing model:

     * Per list
     * Per interested candidate
     * Monthly subscription options.
   * Clear explanation: “You do the interviews, we just fill your pipeline.”

5. **Employer Intake Form**

   * Fields:

     * Name, company, email, phone
     * Location(s)
     * Roles you’re hiring for
     * Expected hiring timeline
     * Budget / salary range
     * Service(s) you’re interested in (checkboxes)
   * CTA: **[Submit]** and follow-up confirmation.

---

### 4.4 Pricing & Grand Slam Offers

**Goal:** Present premium but clear pricing and show superior value vs traditional agencies.

**Sections:**

1. **Comparison Banner**

   * “Traditional Recruiter: 20–25% of salary (~$30–$40K per hire).”
   * “Mosaic: Transparent monthly pricing, more support, less risk.”

2. **Grand Slam Offer #1 – Engineering Hiring Accelerator**

   * Price: $5,000/mo (3-month min)
   * Guarantee: 4th month free if no hire within 90 days
   * Value stack: full-cycle, video-first, strategy calls, etc.
   * CTA: **[Apply for the Accelerator]**

3. **Grand Slam Offer #2 – Fractional TA Elite**

   * Price: $12,500/mo launch
   * Guarantee: if <3 roles filled in 90 days → 1 month free
   * Intended for firms hiring 5–20 roles/year.
   * CTA: **[Book a Strategy Call]**

4. **Grand Slam Offer #3 – Candidate Sourcing Machine**

   * Price: $2,500/mo launch
   * Guarantee: 50% refund if fewer than 10 interested candidates/month.
   * CTA: **[Build My Candidate Pipeline]**

5. **Standard Pricing Table**

   * Summarize per-position tiers + fractional tiers + sourcing + candidate services.
   * Simple, stacked comparison.

---

### 4.5 Candidate Services

**Goal:** Convert engineers & professionals into:

* Freemium Resume Book members
* Paid career-branding clients
* Featured Candidates

**Sections:**

1. **Why Work With Mosaic as a Candidate**

   * Engineer-led recruiters
   * Deep understanding of engineering career paths
   * Special focus on civil & construction roles

2. **Freemium Resume Book (Free Tier)**

   * What they get:

     * Basic profile
     * CV upload
     * Standard visibility to employers
   * CTA: **[Join Free Resume Book]**
   * Form fields:

     * Name, email, location
     * LinkedIn URL
     * Resume upload
     * Role type(s) interested in
     * Experience level

3. **Career Boost Package (Tier 2)**

   * Price: $200 (Launch $100)
   * Includes:

     * Resume review
     * LinkedIn review
     * Interview coaching
     * Listed in Featured Candidates & Resume Book
   * CTA: **[Book Career Boost Session]**
   * Requires integration with payment (Stripe) + scheduling.

4. **Professional Branding Package (Tier 3)**

   * Price: $500 (Launch $250)
   * Includes:

     * Resume rewrite
     * LinkedIn optimization
     * Job search strategy
     * Featured Candidate placement
   * CTA: **[Upgrade My Career Brand]**

5. **Featured Candidate Section Explanation**

   * Benefits:

     * Top-of-list visibility to hiring managers
     * Highlighted profile, headshot, video intro
   * CTA: **[Apply to be a Featured Candidate]**

---

### 4.6 Talent Hub

**Phase 1 (Minimum viable):**

* **Featured Candidates Page**

  * Grid of featured profiles (first names, title, location, years of experience).
  * Each card:

    * Short summary (e.g., “Senior PE – 12 yrs, transportation, NY/NJ”)
    * Skills tags
    * Button: **[Request Info]** → Employer contact form.

**Phase 2 (Later):**

* Searchable Resume Book backend (for Mosaic internal use or employer subscription area).
* Filters:

  * Role type, experience range, location, certifications (EIT/PE), salary band, availability.

---

### 4.7 Resources / Insights

**Goal:** Establish thought leadership and SEO.

**Sections:**

* Blog list with categories:

  * Engineering Hiring
  * Civil/Infrastructure Trends
  * Candidate Tips
* Example articles:

  * “Why Civil Engineers Are in Short Supply in 2025”
  * “How to Hire a PE in Under 90 Days”
  * “How Engineers Can Stand Out on LinkedIn”

---

### 4.8 Contact / Book a Call

**Components:**

1. **Simple Contact Form**

   * Name, email, company, phone, message.
2. **Interest Selection**

   * Employer / Candidate / Partner
3. **Calendly/Booking Embed**

   * 15–30 min discovery call calendar.
4. **Location / Time Zone**

   * “Serving clients across the U.S., based in [your area].”

---

## 5. Core Functional Requirements

* **Forms**

  * Employer intake
  * Candidate intake
  * Featured candidate upgrade request
  * General contact

* **Integrations**

  * Email marketing (e.g., Mailchimp/ConvertKit)
  * Scheduling (Calendly or similar)
  * Payment (Stripe)
  * Back-end: ATS/CRM (Airtable, Recruit CRM, or equivalent)

* **Video-first**

  * Option for candidates to upload/link video intro (YouTube/Vimeo link or recorded via tool like VideoAsk).
  * Admin view for Mosaic to review.

* **Automation**

  * Auto-email confirmations for:

    * Employer form submissions
    * Candidate sign-ups
    * Purchase confirmations (for paid services)

---

## 6. Admin / Back-Office Needs

* Ability to:

  * Add/edit Featured Candidates manually.
  * Update pricing & offers easily.
  * Post and edit blog articles.
  * Download/export candidate & employer form entries (CSV).
* Access control:

  * At least one admin login for you (and future team).

---

## 7. Success Metrics to Track

* Employer KPIs:

  * # of employer form submissions
  * # of call bookings
  * # of roles submitted
* Candidate KPIs:

  * # of Resume Book sign-ups
  * # of Career Boost / Branding purchases
  * # of Featured Candidate upgrades
* Site metrics:

  * Traffic by page
  * Conversion rate from Home → Book a Call
  * Conversion rate for candidate offers
